sources: Enemy pages: Ska'sa Ka'sos, Juda R'kasso, Foo'Ori Darkasso, Shendi Darkasso, Sphon'Dato Darkasso, Eh'Lleve-Teh Darkasso, Levatee Darkasso, Levarsee Darkasso
GAP: the wiki has no wave table, boss table or map events for Room 1665; waves here are a placeholder progression. pickups, chest_rules and reaper reuse other-stage file content.

stage.name: Room 1665
stage.type: Hidden stage (unlocked by casting the spell 'forbiddenbox'); wiki id DEVILROOM
stage.spawn_type: Standard-style spawns, but enemies do NOT despawn when outrun or off-screen

modifiers.health_scaling_note: Enemies carry 'HP x Level': health multiplier = player level (1 + 1.0*(level-1)). The wiki lists per-enemy hp as ranges (e.g. Ska'sa Ka'sos 5-50) without explaining them; treated as base hp x player level.

stage.modifiers_note: Wiki infobox: player-speed x1.9, enemy-speed x1.9, projectile-speed x1.15, greed x1.5, luck x1, enemy-health x1, enemy-min 20, starting spawns 0, dchance 50% (max 80%), dmax 20. All modifiers except Arcanas and Limit Break are disabled; Curse, Charm and Power Creep options are disabled. enemy_min_multiplier is 1 here; the infobox enemy-min 20 is the base minimum used in waves.
stage.spawn_rule: Wave data not on the wiki. Enemy types change depending on rooms unlocked and time elapsed; bosses have less health than non-boss enemies.

relics.position: center of the last (16th) room, due south; unlocked after 1665 total kills

stage.destructibles: Light sources (blue brazier) at predictable fixed positions, ~11-12 per corridor between rooms; slowly respawn.

layout.size_note: 16 rooms including the spawn room, stacked southward and linked by corridors; player starts in a small locked room. Room dimensions not given on the wiki.
layout.obstacles: Solid walls and locked doors; rooms and corridors are closed. Braziers (light sources) line the corridors (~11-12 each).
layout.theme: Infernal, bottomless haunted halls in a huge contraption; darkens progressively with each unlocked room and lights up fully when the final room opens. Blood drips from the top of the screen after enough kills; occasional flashes of a large wall eye, arm shadows reaching up, and a toothy mouth outside the room. Music: Call of the Bloodmoon.
layout.special_mechanics: Enemy health scales with player level: enemy HP multiplier = player level (HP x Level, i.e. 1 + 1.0*(level-1)). +90% move speed (player and enemy x1.9), +50% gold (greed x1.5). Door progression by TOTAL KILLS: rooms unlock at 100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 600, 700, 800, 900, 1000, 1100, 1200, 1300, 1400 and 1665 kills (15 unlocks -> 16 rooms). Starts locked in the small spawn room. No Arcana pick at start: the Arcana chest lies in the room unlocked at 100 kills. Enemies never despawn when outrun. Stage gets darker each room unlocked; fully lit at the final room. Darkasso relic in the final room ends the point of the run (wiki: little point continuing after 1665 kills). Only Arcanas and Limit Break modifiers apply; Curse/Charm/Power Creep off. Bosses exist but no boss table is documented.

waves.notes: PLACEHOLDER: wiki gives no wave table for Room 1665; pool/enemy_min invented as a rising-difficulty progression from enemy hp/damage ranges. Real game varies types by rooms unlocked and elapsed time.
30:00+: The Reaper (same as other stages; not explicitly documented for this stage).

unsupported_events_note: No map events documented on the wiki.

chest_rules.roll_order: 5-item chance first, then 3-item, then 1-item; each chance is multiplied by player Luck; compared to a random 0-100 per roll; fallback_level is the chest tier if all fail.
chest_rules.evo: If an evolution is available, evo-flagged chests can evolve a weapon (generally one per chest); the wiki table's evo flag meaning is inferred from the treasure template.
chest_rules.reward_flags_note: reward1/reward4/reward5 flags exist in the treasure template; their exact meaning is not documented on the pages read (unknown).
chest_rules.wiki_table_parse_note: First-minute-of-stage values: '1:00 ... evo=1' etc. copied verbatim; a blank evo means not evolving.
chest_rules.fractional_chance_note: Minute 3 Giant Mummy chest lists a 0.1% 5-item chance; code that int()s the chance reads it as 0.

reaper.spawn: 30:00 (all on-screen enemies cleared), then one additional Reaper each minute afterwards (unless endless mode)
reaper.hp_note: multiplied by player level when spawned (HP x Level)
reaper.knockback_note: negative: hits drag it toward the player
reaper.behaviour: Rushes the player and deals 65,535 damage, ending the run. Surviving to the end rewards 500 gold (revive bonuses stack +100 each up to +400). Orologion/other freeze can freeze it per wiki text (wiki lists freeze resistance 1 but the text says freezing is possible - contradictory; Orologion freeze goes through freeze resistance).

light_sources.spawn_location: predetermined braziers in corridors, ~11-12 per corridor; slowly respawn
light_sources.drops_note: Drop table not documented for this stage; assumed coins and small coin bags (placeholder).
